headingText: Sec. 11-1402. Limitations on backing. (a) The driver of a vehicle shall not back the same unless such movement can be made with safety and without interfering with other traffic.

blocks.text: Sec. 11-1402. Limitations on backing. (a) The driver of a vehicle shall not back the same unless such movement can be made with safety and without interfering with other traffic.

blocks.label: (b)
blocks.text: (b) The driver of a vehicle shall not back the same upon any shoulder or roadway of any controlled-access highway.
